notes: Partition verified: 27 source / 40 target, each used once.
רְבָבָה carries *to multiply* and נָתַן the light *I caused*, which is rule 44's subtraction applied to the idiom *made thee a myriad*.
*thy* on שָׁדַיִם is supplied to make the anarthrous noun a noun phrase, treated as rule 29's supplied determiner rather than `added`; the same convention is used at 16.43 for *thy head*.
